trajectory_clusters.common_pattern: Map a target calendar/fiscal period to the correct Treasury Bulletin file(s) accounting for publication lag (M-month bulletin carries data through M-1 or M-2), then assemble values across multiple bulletins when a range is requested.
trajectory_clusters.evidence: Trajectories show repeated date-to-bulletin reasoning: q000 uses 1941_01 for CY1940 data; q003 uses 1954_02 for 1953 and 1941_01 for 1940; q014 uses 1943_01 and 1947_01 for revised figures; q076 assembles Sept 2002 and Sept 2012 from March bulletins of the following year; q095 pulls each Sept 2005-2009 from the September bulletin; q100 reads 1956_08/1956_07 for back-figures; q127 uses 1982_01 for the Dec-31-1981 snapshot.

trajectory_clusters.common_pattern: Inside a bulletin, locate a numbered table, parse multi-level column headers whose positions shift across eras, verify column mapping via sum/cross-bulletin/subtotal/footnote checks, extract values handling units and r/p/-/nan markers, cross-verify across bulletins, then compute a statistic and round/format the answer.
trajectory_clusters.evidence: Column-mapping ambiguity is pervasive: q015/q017 decode the AY-1 4-year column blocks via the May 1970 bulletin labels; q014 resolves a misaligned 1946_09 Table 3 by using the 1947_01 revision; q030 verifies customs columns by summing months to the annual total; q041 confirms FFO-2 column positions across four bulletins; q127 confirms PDO-1 column 2 is the nominal maturity total via a 15178+79990 subtotal check. Computation variety includes geometric mean (q010, q072, q097), CAGR/continuous growth (q048, q113), OLS forecast (q100), R-squared (q041), arc elasticity (q087), centered moving average (q034), population std dev (q039), percent-share change (q058, q067, q108), inflation correction (q003). Rounding/format details differ per question (hundredths/thousandths/tenths/whole/significant digits, bracketed lists, signed numbers, percent-vs-decimal).

trajectory_clusters.common_pattern: Cross-bulletin verification: re-extract the same value from a later bulletin that reproduces back-figures, or confirm a single value across two overlapping bulletins before trusting it.
trajectory_clusters.evidence: q000 cross-checks 1940 defense figures between 1941_01 and 1940_12; q014 confirms 1946 Public works=407 in both 1946_09 and 1947_01; q069 verifies 2002/2012 liabilities across the Dec and Mar bulletins; q095 confirms each FY total in two bulletins; q113 confirms 1945 seigniorage in 1946_02 and 1946_03.

changes.summary: New skill mapping target calendar/fiscal periods to treasury_bulletin_YYYY_MM.txt files with publication-lag rules and multi-bulletin assembly fallback.

New skill covering table location, multi-level column parsing, mapping verification, value extraction with unit/marker handling, cross-bulletin verification, computation, rounding, and output formatting.
